visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair, glasses, and silver hoop earrings stands in a brightly lit room. She is wearing an oversized black T-shirt featuring a 'LALISA' graphic. She points toward the shirt's collar while a text overlay appears at the top center of the frame. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down view of a wooden floor. The woman's hands are seen aligning the shoulder seams of the black T-shirt, which is laid flat. Dotted line graphics appear over the neckline to indicate the cutting path. (3) Using large black scissors, the woman carefully cuts along the curved line of the collar on the flat-laid shirt. The fabric is separated as she moves the blades through the cotton material. (4) Back to a standing medium shot, the woman wears the modified shirt, which now hangs off her right shoulder. She performs a military-style salute. (5) She holds up a small pink hair tie toward the camera. She then turns her back to the camera, demonstrating how she bunches the loose fabric at the back of her waist and secures it with the tie to create a more fitted look. (6) A final reveal shows the woman posing in the completed boat-neck shirt, now styled with a white pearl necklace. She poses with her hands on her hips, winks at the camera, and smiles confidently in front of a round wall mirror.
